story: Refunds for orders paid in a non-default currency are issued in the default currency, so customers get the wrong amount back. A refund should always use the currency of the original payment. Reproduce by paying an order in EUR on a USD store and refunding it.
acceptance_criteria: A refund is issued in the currency of the original payment.
The refunded amount equals the amount paid, with no conversion applied.
A test covers a refund for an order paid in a non-default currency.
out_of_scope: Changing how exchange rates are fetched.
